roomId.description: The room whose identity issues this credential. The recipient MUST hold a signing key for it — it is signing AS the room, not as itself.

signingKeyId.description: Which held key signs. Named explicitly rather than looked up from `roomId`, because nothing maps a DID to a key it was minted with and inventing that mapping would add a lifecycle to get wrong. A key that is not the room's produces a credential that fails to verify against the room's DID document — loud, and at the first use rather than later.

subject.description: The member this admits. Membership is an explicit set of parties, never a role — a room that admitted a role would be a room whose membership its host could compute.

validUntil.description: When membership lapses. Absent means it does not, and removal is then an epoch advance rather than an expiry — see `rooms/epoch/mint`.

Response.title: Rooms Owner Issue Membership — response payload
Response.description: Success response to rooms/owner/issue-membership. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/rooms/owner/issue-membership/0.1#response. The signed VMC naming the member.

credential.description: The signed Verifiable Membership Credential, serialised, for delivery to the member.

credentialId.description: Its `id`, which is how a re-send is told from a renewal.
